title: A trivially copyable groove projection is reachable from the design-time capability surface

needles: ORDER PRESERVATION IS EXPLICITLY NOT PROVIDED
inline groove projection admits the authored table the strict kernel refuses
zero inline groove strength is exact identity including swing

installed_sdk.rationale: core/timebase/include is one of the subsystem header directories PulpInstallRules.cmake installs wholesale, so the new public header ships with the SDK under the already-exported Pulp::timebase target.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No Timeline CLI verb, flag, or handler is added or changed; the projector is a header-only value type with no command surface.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No offline Timeline MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed.

live_product_control.rationale: No runtime control capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes. The projector is constructed and copied by a consumer; it registers nothing with the control platform.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The generated manifest publishes timebase.inline-groove-projector with a typed validated-factory binding, which is what makes the non-order-preserving projection findable by a capability search that would otherwise only surface the strict kernel.
